Maya (docs): FYI drafting relnotes for next doc release — SDK snippet migration + known issue about streaming embeddings tokenization. need quick sanity-checks and link sweep. who's available?
Liam (pm): I can review snippets later today. Are we also calling out Dedicated config changes?
Maya (docs): yes — Dedicated autoscale flags + new `max_batch_latency_ms` example. also a short migration blurb for v0.9 -> v1.0 SDK (rename client methods).
Raj (eng): note: kernel selection changed default for long context models; add note about slight latency spike on first warmup. filed PR #8421 that updates the note.
Sophie (devex): passing PR #8421 through examples review now. I'll leave inline comments on the python snippet path: docs/snippets/sdk/v1/migrate_client.py
Sophie (devex): snippet diff: ```py
# old
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=...)
# new
client = RedwoodClientV1(token=...)
```
Maya (docs): @Sophie can you confirm snippet compiles? I'd like at least one runnable example for the migration guide.
Sophie (devex): ran locally, minor import rename. pushed fix in #8429. also added a small unit test harness to CI.
deploy-bot: PR #8429 merged to main by Sophie (devex) :rocket:
Maya (docs): great — can someone sanity-check the known issues section wording? here's draft: "Streaming embeddings may drop first token for some 3rd-party tokenizers; workaround: set `buffer_tokens=32`". sound OK?
Raj (eng): reword to "Some tokenizers may omit first token in streaming embeddings under certain buffer sizes; set `buffer_tokens=32` as a workaround." short and clear.
Liam (pm): +1. also add link to support article and issue tracker: https://support.redwood.ai/articles/stream-embed-quirk and internal issue RD-4312
Maya (docs): I'll add both links. final ask: someone run the link checker before we publish? I noticed some old redirect loops on /sdk/0.9/examples
Ally (docs-ops): I'll run link-checker now and post results.
Ally (docs-ops): Link check done: 4 warnings, 1 broken (/sdk/0.9/examples -> 404). filing redirect PR #8433.
Maya (docs): perfect. plan: merge relnotes draft after #8433 lands, target publish window tomorrow 10:00 PST. if no objections I'll ship.
Liam (pm): no objections from me. :thumbsup:
Maya (docs): thanks all — I'll post final draft to #announce when published.
